summary: Small rectangular driver PCB (carrier board) with a 4-position screw terminal block on one edge, a 9-pin header plus a separate 2-pin ISET header along the opposite edge, a can capacitor, and one mounting hole in a corner. Dimensions are taken from the stated 0.8 in × 0.9 in board size.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the PCB, which sits against the mounting surface; secured with one M2 or #2 screw through the corner hole.

notes: Footprint (20.32 × 22.86 mm) and hole diameter (0.086 in = 2.18 mm) come from the stated specs, which are marked unverified. Overall height (about 11 mm, including the PCB, terminal block and header pins) is not stated and is a rough estimate from the photos. The hole position is estimated from the pin-label photo and is approximate. The long axis (y) runs along the header edge, and the origin is at the bounding-box center.
